import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import xgboost as xgb
import warnings

# Suppress XGBoost warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Define paths
input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"

train_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv")
test_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv")
sample_submission_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv")
submission_path = os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
template = pd.read_csv(sample_submission_path)

# Get column names from sample submission
column_names = list(template.columns)

# Prepare features - exclude 'Id' column entirely
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c != "Id"]

# Select feature columns
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df["Cover_Type"].copy()
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

# Handle missing values
X_train = X_train.fillna(X_train.median())
X_test = X_test.fillna(X_test.median())

# Split into training and validation (held out from final model training)
X_train_xgb, X_val_xgb, y_train_xgb, y_val_xgb = train_test_split(
    X_train.values,
    y_train,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train if y_train.dtype in ["int64", "float64"] else None,
)

# Convert to correct types for XGBoost
X_train_xgb = X_train_xgb.astype(np.float32)
X_val_xgb = X_val_xgb.astype(np.float32)
X_test_xgb = X_test.values.astype(np.float32)
y_train_cat = y_train_xgb.copy()
y_val_cat = y_val_xgb.copy()

# Train XGBoost classifier
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    use_label_encoder=False,
    eval_metric="mlogloss",
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    min_child_weight=1,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    verbosity=0,
)

model.fit(X_train_xgb, y_train_cat)

# Evaluate on held-out validation set (NOT refitting on full data)
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val_xgb)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val_cat, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy (Hold-Out): {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Predict on test set
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test_xgb)

# Create submission file
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df["Id"], "Cover_Type": y_test_pred})

submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)

print(f"\nSubmission saved to: {submission_path}")
print(
    f"\nFinal Validation Metric (Multi-Class Classification Accuracy): {val_accuracy:.4f}"
)
